preconditions.description: Input consists of exactly two lines: first line is n, second line is the coin denominations.

preconditions.expression: all(c.isdigit() for c in stdin.splitlines()[0].split()) and int(stdin.splitlines()[0].split()[0]) >= 2 and int(stdin.splitlines()[0].split()[0]) <= 100
preconditions.description: First line contains a single integer n (2 ≤ n ≤ 100).
Second line contains n space-separated integers representing coin denominations.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(c) <= 10**6 for c in stdin.splitlines()[1].split())
preconditions.description: Each denomination is a positive integer ≤ 10^6.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'canonical' if all(min_coins(x, S) == greedy_coins(x, S) for x in range(1, sum(S))) else stdout.strip() == 'non-canonical'
postconditions.description: Output is 'canonical' if and only if the greedy algorithm always yields the minimum number of coins for all positive integers x less than the sum of the two largest denominations in S. Otherwise, output is 'non-canonical'.
